en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a large, elegant café or coffee house with rows of square tables and bentwood chairs arranged symmetrically along a central carpeted aisle. There are tall coat racks, wooden columns, and a mezzanine gallery with railings above. At the far end is a counter or bar with illuminated signs and a clock on the wall. The image caption at the bottom reads "Kaffee Nordmeier Essen," indicating the name of the café and its location.
